spec.situation_desc: had a loan application declined with no explanation

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Zara speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s Bronwen Oyelaran. My loan application was declined and nobody’s told me why. I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you’ve been left without an explanation, Bronwen. I’ll look into what I can. Before I discuss your application, could I check your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, that’s matched. I understand why you’re frustrated. I’m logging this as a complaint about the declined application and the lack of explanation.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Good. I want to know what’s going on.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. I’ll make sure the complaint records both points, and I’ll arrange for our complaints team to review the application and the communication you received. I can’t promise what the outcome will be.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Can you at least tell me why it was declined?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can’t see a reason I can reliably give you on this call, so I don’t want to guess. The complaints team will review the decision and explain what they can in their written response.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll submit the complaint today and send you its reference by text. I’ll also check that it’s been assigned to the complaints team and call you by 4 pm tomorrow with an update on that, even if there’s no further decision yet.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: The complaints team will investigate and send you a full written response within 8 weeks. I’ll include your request for an explanation in the complaint.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to summarise: I’m logging your complaint today, I’ll text the reference and call by 4 pm tomorrow with an assignment update, and the team will send a full written response within 8 weeks. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Bronwen. I’m sorry again that you had to chase us for an explanation. Goodbye.
